title: 🐶 Playful Pups & Sweet Adults Ready for Adoption in Hobart - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago Big hearts and wagging tails are waiting for you in Hobart, IN . These adoptable dogs at the Humane Society of Hobart, Inc. are looking for safe, loving homes.
Prissy Breed: Mixed Breed (Medium)
Age: Adult
Gender: Female
Color: Tan/Yellow/Fawn with White
Shelter: Humane Society of Hobart, Inc.
Phone: (219) 942-0103
Prissy is a brave mama who raised seven puppies while fighting parvo . Now that she’s feeling better, her foster says she loves playing with her pups and other dogs. She enjoys running and playing chase with a husky friend and loves fetch with any toy you offer.
She is reported to be very well house-trained if let out regularly , and she does great in the car and in a crate . She was originally found abandoned in a Hobart parking lot with no food or water, and she truly deserves a kind, stable home.
👉 Meet Prissy and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Marz Breed: Chihuahua
Age: Young
Gender: Female
Color: White with Tan/Yellow/Fawn
Shelter: Humane Society of Hobart, Inc.
Phone: (219) 942-0103
Marz is a young Chihuahua girl with a soft white coat and tan markings. She’s on the smaller side, as you’d expect from the breed, and is looking for a home where she can feel safe and loved.
For full details on her personality, training, and any medical info, please contact the shelter.
👉 Meet Marz and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Buttons Breed: Mixed Breed (Medium)
Age: Young
Gender: Male (fixed)
Color: White with Tan/Yellow/Fawn
Shelter: Humane Society of Hobart, Inc.
Phone: (219) 942-0103
Buttons was found on West Wisconsin St wearing a blue collar but with no microchip . He is already neutered (fixed) . The shelter is calling him Buttons while they try to learn more about his past.
If you’re interested in adopting him, or if you recognize this dog and may know his owner , please reach out to the shelter.
👉 Meet Buttons and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Halloween Litter Puppies (Jack o Lantern, Candy, Bones, Ghost, Spider) These pups are part of the Halloween Litter , surrendered to the shelter through a special “mom/puppy package” for accidental litters. As part of this program:
Puppies are spayed/neutered , microchipped , and given age-appropriate vaccines and de-worming before adoption. Mom dog is also spayed, microchipped, and vaccinated free of charge , to help stop the cycle of unwanted litters. All pups share these basics:
